scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.build: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server install
scripts.prestart: node -e "const fs = require('fs'), path = require('path'), cp = require('child_process'); if (!fs.existsSync(path.join(__dirname, 'client/dist/index.html'))) { console.log('Building client dist for production...'); cp.execSync('npm --prefix client run build', { stdio: 'inherit' }); }"
